_comment: Overrides deep-merged onto DEFAULT_POLICY in extensions/guardrails/policy.mjs. Arrays REPLACE the default list, so copy the default first if you only want to add. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
_mode: ask = safe read-only calls run, risky ones prompt (Codex-style: once / session / deny). audit = run everything, log only. enforce = block risky calls.

paths._allowed_roots: Ubuntu set: same as macOS minus /private/tmp (a macOS-only path), plus /var/tmp and /srv.

_profile: dangerous-only = only destructive/irreversible/privileged/secret-exposing calls ask (default). read-only = anything that mutates asks.
